name: Merced County 4-H Youth Development Program
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick at least one project in it. Teens 14 to 19 are Senior Members. You can also join county 4-H activities without a club.
who_can_apply: Youth who are 9 by December 31 of the program year can join as Junior (9 to 10), Intermediate (11 to 13) or Senior (14 to 19) members, and can stay until December 31 of the year they turn 19. Children 5 and up can join as Primary members.
pay_detail: $70 youth enrollment fee for 2026 to 2027, which includes accident and illness insurance. Fee waivers or lower fees may be available.
deadline_text: Youth enrollment for 2026 to 2027 opened August 3, 2026. You can enroll any time in the program year, but you must enroll by December 31, 2026 to show at the fair.
how_to_apply: Contact a club leader first, since some clubs have limited space. Then enroll online in the 4-H enrollment system linked on the New Youth Member page, picking at least one club and one project, and pay your club leader or pay online. Questions: (209) 385-7418.
notes: The club list is on the Merced County 4-H Clubs tab of the site. Teens can also apply to be 4-H camp teen staff (see the Merced 4-H Camp Teen Staff card).
